title: no separate mobile site
name: No separate mobile site — Canada.ca
rule: No separate mobile site — same content on phone and desktop; IA as flat as possible; in-page navigation over menus; limit page weight. Dual-cite USWDS continuity / mobile-friendly without a second origin and Wayfinding Jump to Item (do not merge with USWDS tab-before-main / never-link-externally in-page row).
pass_when: Phone and desktop share the same content origin; IA is flat; in-page nav is preferred over extra menus.
fail_when: A separate mobile origin/site, or a second menu instead of in-page nav on a long page.
overview: Phone and desktop share one content origin; prefer flat IA and in-page nav.
apply_when: Planning Canada.ca information architecture for phone and desktop.
not_when: USWDS tab-before-main or never-link-externally in-page rows — keep separate.
agent_hint: Ship one responsive origin; flatten IA; prefer in-page nav over extra menus.
